description: 8 retrieval probes for pallets/click — a BSD-licensed Python CLI library with @t.overload decorator chains, generic-parameterized abstract classes (ParamType[T]), and decorator-heavy command/group abstractions.

probes.query: how does click handle command grouping and dispatch to subcommands
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: Group class (line 1531) extends Command and adds subcommand routing — core of click's nested-command UX

probes.query: how does click expose context state between parent and child commands
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: Context class (line 185) carries the parent chain (`self.parent`), shared object (`.obj`), and meta dict (`.meta`) — the canonical answer to context-between-commands

probes.query: how does click validate that an option value is one of a fixed set of choices
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: Choice class (line 253) implements ParamType for enum-like options — exercises the conversion + error path on bad input

probes.query: click command decorator that turns a function into a Command object
probes.notes: Symbol-anchored probe: command function in decorators.py is the @click.command entry point. Has 5 @t.overload signatures + 1 implementation (line 168)
Symbol-anchored probe: find_root method (line 676) walks self.parent chain to top-level context — small, signature-anchored target

probes.query: ParamType convert method that turns raw string input into a typed value
probes.notes: Symbol-anchored probe: ParamType.convert (line 110) is the abstract conversion method overridden by every concrete param type

probes.query: @t.overload decorator chain for the click command function signature
probes.notes: Grammar-edge-case probe: click.command has 5 @t.overload-decorated stub signatures (lines 138/144/153/163/168) followed by the real implementation. Exercises tree-sitter-python's handling of decorated overload stubs that are typing-only — the chunker must not collapse them and must surface the implementation, not just the first overload

probes.query: ParamType generic abstract base class with TypeVar bound and ABC inheritance
probes.notes: Grammar-edge-case probe: ParamType (line 37) is `class ParamType(t.Generic[ParamTypeValue], abc.ABC):` — exercises tree-sitter-python's parsing of multiple-inheritance with a Generic subscript and an ABC marker class, plus PEP 484 TypeVar bound (ParamTypeValue)
